description: Core Setup & Architecture: Modern web app initialized with TypeScript strict mode, vanilla CSS design tokens, Vitest unit testing, and Playwright verification script.
Accessory Database & Registry: Comprehensive master catalog of SkyBlock accessories with base rarities, Magical Power values, categories, sources, and upgrade family hierarchies.
NBT Decoder & Accessory Bag Parser: Robust parser decoding base64-gzipped NBT data into structured accessory items (ID, name, rarity, reforge, enrichment, lore).
Owned vs Missing Accessories Engine: Accurate comparison engine matching player inventory against master catalog, resolving upgrade tiers so higher tiers fulfill lower tiers.
Magical Power & Bag Statistics: Accurate computation of total Magical Power (MP), completion rate, rarity breakdown, and enrichment count.
Profile & Player Data Loader: Support for loading player data via username/UUID/Pixel ID with policy caching, pre-bundled realistic profiles (Endgame, Midgame, Earlygame), and raw Base64 NBT input.
Visual Design & Hero Header: Premium dark-mode Minecraft aesthetic with glassmorphism, dynamic glowing rarity badges, policy disclaimer banner, and interactive stats overview.
Accessory Grid & Multi-Filter System: High-performance interactive grid with status filtering (All, Owned, Missing, Upgradable), rarity filters, category tabs, and real-time search.

Accessory Card & Interactive Detail Modal: Minecraft-styled visual tooltips and detail modal showing rarity coloring, lore, stat bonuses, reforges, enrichments, and acquisition guides for missing items.
Smart MP Optimization & Upgrade Recommendations: Intelligent recommendation panel displaying the easiest and highest value missing accessories to upgrade for maximum MP gain.
Audio Feedback & Responsive Design: Synthesized Web Audio API sound effects for inventory interactions (clicks, chimes, bag opens) and fully responsive layout across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Policy Compliance & Code Quality Gates: Full CraftersMC policy compliance, zero ESLint/TypeScript warnings, 100% Vitest unit test pass for pure logic, and modular source files under 300 lines.
